 assert source.count(old)==1,(name,source.count(old));ns={};exec(source.replace(old,new),ns)
 try:ns['selfcheck']()
 except AssertionError:results.append({'mutation':name,'detected':True})
 else:raise AssertionError(name)

s=Path(__file__).read_text();Path('collab/gmyhf-30549-recheck-mutations.json').write_text(json.dumps({'global_number':30549,'results':results,'procedure_source':s,'procedure_sha256':hashlib.sha256(s.encode()).hexdigest()},ensure_ascii=False,indent=2)+'\n');print(len(results),'种证书验证器变异检出')
